Generated and schema-validated against PLATO v0.4.0 (release 0.4.0, commit ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832). This serialisation is an adaptation and carries the same terms. plato_commit=ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832
gazetteer.contributor: Conversion: Stephen Gadd (github.com/docuracy/deep). Data: English Place-Name Society, digitised by DEEP, published by Jisc.
